candidates.title: RoboSimStudio: An Interactive Toolkit for Human and Agent Rapid Real2Sim of Robot Manipulation Tasks
candidates.discovered_from: fixed-source and broad primary-source delta scan
candidates.why_candidate: Makes contact modeling and physical parameter revision explicit, editable, and agent-operable rather than hiding them in a one-shot real-to-sim pipeline.

candidates.title: AutoRSR: Automated Real-to-Sim-to-Real Data Generation for Scalable Robot Learning
candidates.discovered_from: fixed-source and broad primary-source delta scan
candidates.why_candidate: Automates object extraction, metric scene registration, trajectory generation, and sim-to-real data scaling in one pipeline.

candidates.title: PhySGA: A Physics-Space Grounded Agentic Framework for Generalizable and Interactive 3D Composition
candidates.discovered_from: fixed-source and broad primary-source delta scan
candidates.why_candidate: Grounds agentic 3D composition in closed-loop contact dynamics and executable simulator actions rather than static coordinate prediction.

candidates.title: From Failures to Learnable Worlds: Policy-Conditioned Environment Generation for Navigation Agents
candidates.discovered_from: fixed-source and broad primary-source delta scan
candidates.why_candidate: Uses an agent's measured weaknesses—not generic realism or difficulty—to drive environment generation and iterative adaptation.

candidates.title: PAWA: Panoramic Action-conditioned World Modeling for Multiple Agents
candidates.discovered_from: fixed-source and broad primary-source delta scan
candidates.why_candidate: Introduces panoramic shared state and aligned multiplayer action data for scalable multi-agent world modeling.

candidates.title: DeSpatial: The devil of Agentic Spatial Reasoning Lies in 3D Itself
candidates.discovered_from: fixed-source and broad primary-source delta scan
candidates.why_candidate: Diagnoses perception as the dominant bottleneck and separates scene reconciliation from downstream reasoning tools.

candidates.title: DynThinker: Unifying Static 3D and Dynamic 4D Spatial Reasoning
candidates.discovered_from: fixed-source and broad primary-source delta scan
candidates.why_candidate: Targets non-uniform spatial-dynamic interference at parameter-group level instead of training separate static and dynamic models.

candidates.title: T2-z: Test-Time Optimization of Environment Latents for Robotic World Models
candidates.discovered_from: fixed-source and broad primary-source delta scan
candidates.why_candidate: Infers unsupervised environment factors such as friction, mass, and rules through test-time latent optimization.

candidates.title: GeoState: Learning View-Decoupled Geometry States for 3D World Modeling
candidates.discovered_from: fixed-source and broad primary-source delta scan
candidates.why_candidate: Decouples predictive geometry state from viewpoint while preserving one context-derived scale over rollout.

candidates.title: OneWM: Can World and Action Modeling Benefit Each Other under Unified Causal Training?
candidates.discovered_from: fixed-source and broad primary-source delta scan
candidates.why_candidate: Provides controlled evidence that forward modeling improves policies and action learning improves multi-view world prediction in the same architecture.

candidates.title: What Matters for World Modeling in Vision-Language-Action Models?
candidates.discovered_from: fixed-source and broad primary-source delta scan
candidates.why_candidate: Separates representation, integration paradigm, and backbone effects that prior systems change simultaneously.

candidates.title: LIBERO-PeRM: Benchmarking Personalized Robotic Manipulation
candidates.discovered_from: fixed-source and broad primary-source delta scan
candidates.why_candidate: Separates robotic task success from how a user wants the task performed with reusable, automatically scored preference variables.

candidates.title: Orbia: Do Generated Videos Form a Consistent 3D World?
candidates.discovered_from: fixed-source and broad primary-source delta scan
candidates.why_candidate: Systematically tests newly generated regions for persistence as well as cross-view geometric agreement and minute-long return consistency.

candidates.title: ForceBench: Benchmarking Force Integration for Robotic Manipulation
candidates.discovered_from: fixed-source and broad primary-source delta scan
candidates.why_candidate: Provides a unified protocol that separates force-fusion architecture effects from task and control differences.

candidates.title: TacClaw-Infinity: A Large-Scale Vision-Tactile-Language-Action Dataset for Dexterous Manipulation
candidates.discovered_from: fixed-source and broad primary-source delta scan
candidates.why_candidate: Combines unprecedented VTLA scale with contact segmentation, subtasks, spatial grounding, and collection independent of the target robot.

candidates.title: Active Generative Simulation: Meta-Learning What to Simulate for Sim-and-Real Policy Co-Training
candidates.discovered_from: fixed-source and broad primary-source delta scan
candidates.why_candidate: Turns simulator data generation into a downstream-performance optimization problem rather than uniform sampling or manual alignment.

candidates.title: Perceive, Predict, and Plan: a Unified World Action Model for Egocentric Dexterous Manipulation
candidates.discovered_from: broad primary-source delta scan
candidates.why_candidate: Official project surface returned access controls and representative unedited execution/generation quality could not be judged confidently.

candidates.title: VLA-Delta: Learning Physical State Transition for Vision-Language-Action Models
candidates.discovered_from: broad primary-source delta scan
candidates.why_candidate: Relevant but incremental relative to existing future-state and world-action entries; project relevance/impact prior remained below 3.

candidates.title: VeriVLA: Adaptive Test-Time Verification for Flow-Based VLAs with Latent World Models
candidates.discovered_from: broad primary-source delta scan
candidates.why_candidate: Useful verifier, but narrow three-task evidence and no confirmed public demo/code surface kept impact below threshold.

candidates.title: Mallea: Building, Steering, and Memorizing Worlds with Coding Agent
candidates.discovered_from: broad primary-source delta scan
candidates.why_candidate: Promising agentic world-building signal, but official project/code/demo evidence was not found in this run.

candidates.title: GRASE: Geometry-native Real-to-sim Agentic Scene Modeling from Video
candidates.discovered_from: broad primary-source delta scan
candidates.why_candidate: Strong fit, but no official inspectable project/demo surface was found and the central comparison includes an unreleased model.
